hero.title: Your AI Resume Assistant,

features.subtitle: Everything you need to stand out — works with LinkedIn, Indeed, and Wuzzuf.

howItWorks.title: Up and Running in 4 Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From setup to your first optimized resume in under 2 minutes.

step1.title: Generate Your API Key
step1.description: Log in to the Civify dashboard and generate your personal API key. It's free and takes 10 seconds.

step2.title: Install the Extension
step2.description: Download the Civify CV Browser Extension from the Chrome Web Store and pin it to your toolbar.

step3.title: Log In with Your API Key
step3.description: Open the extension popup, paste your API key, and you're connected to your Civify account.

step4.title: Click on Any Job Page
step4.description: Visit any job listing on LinkedIn, Indeed, or Wuzzuf. The extension automatically extracts the job description — just click and choose your action: Mask CV, Tailor Resume, or Generate Cover Letter.

language.title: Built for a Bilingual World
language.subtitle: Switch between English and Arabic with full RTL support — your output matches your audience.
language.feature1Desc: Switch the extension UI between English and Arabic with a single click. The interface adapts direction automatically.
language.feature2Desc: Choose whether your tailored resume or cover letter is generated in English or Arabic — independent of the UI language.
language.feature3Desc: Arabic documents are generated with proper right-to-left formatting, correct alignment, and native typography.

privacy.title: Your Data, Your Control
privacy.subtitle: We built the extension with privacy-first principles. Here's exactly how it works.
privacy.card1Desc: Choose exactly which fields to redact — name, email, phone, address. You preview the masked version before sharing. Nothing is changed permanently.
privacy.card2Desc: The extension sends only the job description text and your CV content to our servers for processing. No browsing data, no LinkedIn credentials, no tracking.
privacy.card3Desc: Generated documents are saved to your Civify account. You can view, download, or delete them at any time from the dashboard.
privacy.note: We don't access your LinkedIn account, passwords, or any data beyond the job description text visible on the page.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the CV Browser Extension.

q1.question: How does the extension work with job platforms?
q1.answer: When you're on a job listing page on LinkedIn, Indeed, or Wuzzuf, click the extension button. It automatically extracts the job description from the page and lets you choose your action — tailor your resume, generate a cover letter, or mask your CV. It does not access any job platform accounts or credentials.

q2.question: What is an API key and how do I get one?
q2.answer: An API key is a unique code that connects the Chrome extension to your Civify account. You can generate one for free by logging into your dashboard at civify.cv/dashboard and navigating to the API Keys section. Simply copy the key and paste it into the extension.

q3.question: Does the extension support Arabic?
q3.answer: Yes! The extension fully supports both English and Arabic. You can switch the UI language and choose your output language independently. Arabic outputs are generated with proper RTL formatting and native typography.

q4.question: What does CV masking do exactly?
q4.answer: CV masking redacts personal details from your resume — such as your full name, email address, phone number, and physical address — so you can share it safely with recruiters or on public job boards without exposing sensitive information.

q5.question: Is my data private and safe?
q5.answer: Yes. The extension only sends the job description text and your CV content for processing. We don't collect browsing data, LinkedIn credentials, or any other personal information. Generated documents are stored in your Civify account and can be deleted at any time.

q6.question: How accurate is the cover letter generation?
q6.answer: The AI generates cover letters based on the specific LinkedIn job description and your CV content, ensuring relevance to the role. While we recommend reviewing and personalizing the output, most users find the generated letters are 80-90% ready to send.

q7.question: Will the tailored resume pass ATS systems?
q7.answer: Yes. The tailoring engine optimizes your resume by aligning keywords, skills, and experience phrasing with the job description — which is exactly what Applicant Tracking Systems scan for. Users report significantly improved match scores after tailoring.

q8.question: Is the extension free? What about pricing?
q8.answer: The extension itself is free to install. Your usage is tied to your Civify account plan. Free accounts include a limited number of actions per month, while paid plans offer unlimited usage. Visit the Plans page for current pricing details.
